title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.40578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. translated_title: VeriCUA：将验证转化为计算机使用智能体的智能体式探索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.40578v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在桌面、移动和网页环境中构建和扩展计算机使用智能体（CUA），需要可靠的任务完成验证，以支持数据整理、评估和强化学习。典型的自动化方法是通过视觉语言模型（VLM）判断轨迹，或生成程序来检查应用状态。然而，这两种方法都依赖于对复杂数字环境的局部视图。VLM 判断器仅限于所提供的观察内容，而生成的程序则依赖于可访问的状态。这些局部视图可能遗漏决定性证据，或使完成判断缺乏充分依据。针对不同平台和访问设置定制单独的验证器还会带来额外的工程成本。我们提出 VeriCUA，一个平台无关的验证框架，通过智能体探索实现验证。它将验证视为动态的证据收集与评估过程，在统一的流程中同时适用于在线和离线设置，并可跨平台和观察（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: VeriCUA 提出了一个平台无关的验证框架，将任务完成验证转化为智能体式的动态证据收集与评估，解决了 VLM 判断器和生成程序因依赖局部视图而无法可靠验证计算机使用智能体任务完成的局限。
en_tdlr: VeriCUA introduces a platform-agnostic framework that treats task-completion verification as agentic exploration through dynamic evidence gathering and assessment, overcoming the partial-view limitations of VLM judges and generated programs when verifying computer-using agents.
